chunks: They rejoice at the kindness and mercy of God; and God does not suffer the wages of the faithful to go waste.
ai.seo_question: What do believers rejoice in according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the martyrdom of the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating that their joy stems not merely from reward but from the immediate realization of divine proximity and favor. It underscores the concept of 'Fadl' (grace) as a distinct, abundant gift that ensures the believer's efforts are never in vain, reinforcing the theological certainty of divine justice.
